**Finding: compliant** (rule IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data)

The document meets the **preferred** position on every material term:

- **§14.1** — we own Customer Data, our confidential information, our provided material and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right ("No right transfers to Vendor except...").
- **§14.2** — Deliverables vest in us on creation, with an express Vendor assignment, equivalent personnel assignments, and further assurances.
- **§14.3 + §13.2** — Vendor retains Vendor Technology (acceptable), but embedded Vendor Technology carries a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works, plus a duty to identify material Vendor Technology and not to embed restrictive third-party material.
- **§14.4** — no joint ownership unless separately signed with exploitation rights; feedback is voluntary and our own use rights are preserved.
- **Definitions** — "Customer Data" captures derived output and excludes only anonymized non-linkable telemetry; "Vendor Technology" expressly excludes Customer Data and our pre-existing IP, closing the usual back-door grab. **§15.1** adds no sale, no advertising use, no cross-customer combination and no model training without consent.

No assignment of our IP or data to Vendor and no aggregate/derived-data ownership grab appears in the agreement, so no redline was proposed.
